title: Evening hours
body: Open until 21:00 Tuesday to Thursday since August. A third of evening visitors had not been in for a year.

title: Homework club
body: Four afternoons a week with volunteer tutors. 140 regular students by December.

title: Repair café
body: Monthly. 610 items fixed, mostly lamps, bikes and clothes.

title: Local history archive
body: 2,300 photographs digitised and catalogued, most donated by readers.
